tools.name: quest_get_capabilities
tools.description: Returns supported quest types, puzzle engines, reserved facts (lives, coins, rating) and ID rules of the UMOV quest engine.

tools.name: quest_get_schema
tools.description: Returns the JSON Schema for bare quest graphs and versioned umov.quest-package bundles.

tools.name: quest_validate
tools.description: Authoritative structural validator. Checks broken edge references, invalid types and cycles; returns valid, errors (JSON pointers), warnings and non-blocking suggestions.

tools.name: quest_simulate
tools.description: Static reachability analyzer. Reports reachable locations and endings, dead ends, max rewards and enhancement suggestions.
